panoramaPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production Unity VR skybox texture, an exact 2:1 equirectangular full spherical 360 x 180 degree panorama, highest available native resolution, ideally 4096x2048 or higher. The attached image is STYLE AND SKY REFERENCE ONLY. Recreate its extraordinarily beautiful rich luminous cotton candy carnival SKY and atmospheric distant surroundings, as faithfully as possible, not its foreground gameplay map or diagram.
Full-bleed seamless panorama: beautiful lavender and periwinkle upper sky, sweeping peach-pink clouds lit by a golden sunset, warm creamy-yellow glowing horizon, enormous fluffy volumetric pink/lilac/blue cotton candy cloud banks below the horizon and throughout the lower hemisphere. The lower hemisphere must be detailed fluffy clouds all the way to the nadir, not flat color, water, terrain or a disk. Wispy sunlit clouds overhead, painterly photoreal 3D animation film quality, juicy saturated yet delicate pastels, gorgeous light scattering and soft golden rim light, immense atmospheric depth.
At the DISTANT horizon only, scattered small dreamy carnival silhouettes peeking above clouds: Ferris wheels, fairytale striped circus spires, tiny suspended golden bulb garlands, a few faraway pastel striped hot air balloons. These are atmospheric distant background scale, no nearby rides and no central subject. Main golden sunset centered at longitude 180 degrees; vary cloud shapes naturally around all 360 degrees. Upper third open blue-lavender sky, middle horizon peach/gold/pink cloud drama, lower half rich soft cloud sea. Perfect full spherical equirectangular projection: horizon exactly halfway up image, horizontal left/right edges seamlessly matching color/cloud continuity, progressively stretched poles with no visible pinching landmarks. No foreground map, blocks, towers, playable island, platform, characters, labels, text, arrows, frames, watermarks, inset panels. Match the supplied reference's cloud rendering, palette, luminous carnival atmosphere extremely closely. Output ONLY the usable panorama texture, not a skybox mockup, not a cubemap cross or multiple panels.

Sun centered just above the horizon. Pink golden cloud sea below, lavender wispy sky above, distant carnival wheel and tiny spires around lower horizon.. Camera projection exactly 90 degree horizontal and vertical rectilinear FOV, camera centered in same floating carnival cloud environment as reference. Horizon passes through vertical image center on horizontal faces. Same extraordinarily beautiful juicy luminous soft 3D animation film cloud rendering, peach-gold sunset glow and lavender blue upper sky as reference.
